help_text:
Usage: folder2epub [OPTIONS] FOLDER

Convert an image folder into an EPUB.

Options:
  --ocr                       Run OCR
  --ocr-engine ENGINE         mlx | paddle | manga | tesseract
  --ocr-model MODEL           MLX model: auto | mobile | server
  --lang LANGUAGE             OCR language (default: ja)
  --ui-lang LANGUAGE          CLI message language (ko | en)
  --locale-dir PATH           External i18n resource directory
  --recursive                 Convert nested image folders into separate EPUBs
  --output PATH               Output path for one EPUB
  --output-dir PATH           EPUB output directory
  --mode MODE                 hybrid | text | image
  --force-ocr                 Ignore the OCR cache
  --title TEXT                Book title
  --author TEXT               Author
  --cover PATH                Cover image
  --epub-language CODE        EPUB language code
  --help                      Show this help
mode_error: --mode must be one of hybrid, text, image.
engine_error: --ocr-engine must be one of auto, mlx, paddle, manga, tesseract.
